headword: {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}

definitions.explanation: The indigestible parts of plant foods that aid digestion and promote health. A commonly discussed topic in Japanese health and nutrition contexts. Composed of 食物 (food) + 繊維 (fiber).

examples.japanese: {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{取|と}ろう→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便秘|べんぴ}→便秘：05383_benpi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: A lack of dietary fiber can easily lead to constipation.

notes:
USAGE:
{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} is a standard nutritional term frequently seen on food packaging, in health articles, and in doctor-patient conversations. It is often abbreviated to ⟦{食物|しょくもつ}→食物：03761_shokumotsu⟧せんい in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧ (rich in dietary fiber)
- {食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to consume dietary fiber)
- ⟦{水溶性|すいようせい}→水溶性：23155_suiyousei⟧{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} (soluble dietary fiber)
- {不溶性|ふようせい}{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい} (insoluble dietary fiber)
